# Heartbeat extension

## Overview

Peers exchange HEARTBEAT frames to detect dead connections. A peer that receives no frame of any kind for three heartbeat intervals closes the connection with error IDLE_TIMEOUT.

## Negotiation

Each peer advertises a heartbeat interval in its SETTINGS frame. The effective interval is the larger of the two advertised values, and never less than 1 second.
section_request: Write the next section, on HEARTBEAT frame handling.
strong:
## Frame handling

A peer sends HEARTBEAT when it has sent no other frame for one effective interval; any frame resets the idle timer, so busy connections send none. HEARTBEAT carries no payload and is not acknowledged. A peer that has received no frame for three effective intervals closes with IDLE_TIMEOUT. Implementations may jitter sending by up to 10% to avoid synchronized bursts.
weak:
## Frame handling

A peer sends HEARTBEAT every effective interval regardless of other traffic, and the receiver must answer with HEARTBEAT_ACK. The effective interval is the smaller of the two advertised values. A peer that misses two consecutive acknowledgements closes with IDLE_TIMEOUT. Implementations may jitter sending by up to 10%.
